launch-desk.sentence: Most of the cuts land on Hearth, the company's smart home division.
Ferngrove expects to book $310 million in charges, most of it for severance.

byteward.sentence: Ferngrove plans to lay off about 2,000 employees.
CEO Lena Marchbanks announced the cuts in a memo to staff.
Most of the affected jobs are in Hearth, the company's smart home unit.
Ferngrove will also stop selling its Hearth Panel smart display.
Laid-off workers will get at least 16 weeks of pay.
It's the company's second round of cuts this year, after 900 jobs went in March.
